notes: No usable evidence obtained. Fayette's official May 19, 2026 primary results are published only on the Clarity/Scytl site, which blocked automated access (HTTP 403). The county's 2021 and 2023 municipal primary result PDFs contain no committee contests and the scanned April 2024 primary certification covers federal/state offices only, so committee seats are presumably elected in gubernatorial-year primaries, but this was not confirmed. No Republican committee candidate list or roster was found. The precincts array is empty and totals.precincts (77) comes from the map's counties.geojson; seat totals are 0 because no seat-level record exists, and every seat should be read as unknown.
